intro_birch: Welcome... to the world of POKÉMON.
Long ago, this world was an untamed place, shaped by ancient forces.
From the land, the sea, and the sky, mysterious creatures emerged.
At first, humans and these creatures lived far apart, fearful of the unknown.
But over time, through courage and kindness, they learned to understand one another.
They helped each other survive, battled side by side, and forged an unbreakable bond.
Today, we call these magnificent partners... POKÉMON!
Now, it is time for your own journey to begin. Tell me... what is your name?
